subject: Structuring a hybrid commit for per-token pricing and model premiums
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluating Redwood for high-volume embeddings + chat usage

Hi Karthik and Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week. Nimbus is evaluating Redwood for a mixed workload: heavy embeddings for search (roughly 6-8B tokens equivalent per month) plus intermittent chat/generation spikes for clinical assistant features (peaks up to 500M tokens/day).

Two quick asks as we move toward procurement:
- Do you offer per-token volume discounts within a usage-based commit (e.g., breakpoints at 1B, 5B, 10B tokens)?
- How do you handle pricing for premium models vs. standard models (we plan to use a high-accuracy embedding model and occasionally a premium chat model)? Is there a surcharge multiplier or separate SKU for embeddings?

I've attached our rough usage summary and current procurement checklist. Can you propose an initial commercial structure and point out any limits we should be aware of (rollovers, minimums, premia)?

Regards,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health
Attachments: nimbus_usage_summary_nov2026.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood for high-volume embeddings + chat usage

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and thanks for the details. High level response and a suggested commercial framework below. Attaching a concise pricing slide deck that maps to each point.

Proposed approach (summary):
- Hybrid monthly commit with stepped per-token discounts. Example breakpoints: 0-1B tokens: base rate; 1B-5B: 10% off base; 5B-10B: 20% off base; 10B+: 30% off base.
- Model differentiation: premium model surcharge multiplier (example: 1.3x for premium chat models). Embeddings: priced as a separate SKU based on tokens for generation embeddings or fixed per-embedding unit for vector-only workloads — we recommend per-embed unit for at-scale vector workloads to simplify billing.
- Rollovers: optional capped rollover credits (allowed up to 30 days, capped at 20% of committed monthly volume).
- Term: 12-month commit recommended to get best pricing; we can discuss 24-month if you want deeper discounts.

Questions for you:
1) Is your usage steady month-to-month or highly spiky beyond the embeddings baseline?
2) Would you prefer per-embedding-unit pricing for the search index?

Next steps: I can put together a draft SOW and pricing worksheet reflecting your exact numbers. Attached: pricing_slides_nov2026.pptx.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing_slides_nov2026.pptx
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood for high-volume embeddings + chat usage

Thanks Karthik — that framing helps. A couple of clarifying points from procurement and finance:

- We prefer predictable unit economics for the embeddings workload. If you offer a per-embedding-unit SKU for vector writes/reads that maps to our index size, that would be ideal.
- Regarding premium model multiplier: because embeddings will be our majority of tokens, a high multiplier materially changes our spend. Would Redwood consider a temporary reduced premium multiplier for the first 6 months while we ramp (e.g., 1.25x instead of 1.3x or 1.4x)?
- We also need to know whether unused committed tokens can be rolled into future months (rollover) and under what cap.

Attached: Nimbus procurement checklist (for your legal/procurement team).

Best,
Sarah
Attachments: nimbus_procurement_checklist.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing request from Nimbus Health — request for exception guidance (Deal RDW-2026-7843)

Team — forwarding Nimbus' asks. Key commercial asks to consider:
- Allow a per-embedding-unit SKU for the bulk index workload (they estimate 6-8B token equivalent per month consumed by embedding writes/reads).
- Reduce premium multiplier to 1.25x for the first 6 months across the specified premium chat models; after six months revert to standard multiplier (1.3x) unless usage exceeds 10B tokens.
- Enable 30-day rollovers capped at 20% of monthly committed volume.

Can we support the temporary premium concession and per-embed SKU? If legal needs special language for rollovers, please flag. I intend to give them a firm commercial answer tomorrow to keep momentum.

Thanks — Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing request from Nimbus Health — request for exception guidance (Deal RDW-2026-7843)

Karthik — thanks for the summary. I discussed with finance and product pricing. Proposed counter that balances revenue protection and win probability:

- Commit tiers: keep stepped discounts but shift breakpoints to 0-500M, 500M-3B, 3B-8B, 8B+ to reflect their skew toward embeddings.
- Embeddings SKU: offer a per-embedding-unit SKU for vector-only operations at a fixed per-embed rate for the first 12 months, with a review at month 9. This simplifies forecasting for them.
- Premium model multiplier: approve a temporary 1.3x multiplier for premium chat models for months 1-6; revert to 1.35x months 7-12, then standard thereafter. This gives a measurable concession without full write-down.
- Rollover: approve 30-day rollovers capped at 20% of monthly commit. No perpetual rollovers.
- One-time onboarding credit: $25k credit applied in month 1 to offset migration indexing costs.

Legal will draft language for rollovers and for specifying which SKUs qualify as premium. I approve moving forward with this counter and sending a SOW + DocuSign. Please route the SOW to procurement and CC Rachel for technical onboarding coordination.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood for high-volume embeddings + chat usage — proposed commercial terms

Sarah — thanks for the quick clarifications. Based on internal approvals, here is the proposed commercial structure for Nimbus (Deal RDW-2026-7843):

1) Commit and discounts
- Hybrid monthly commit with breakpoints at 0-500M, 500M-3B, 3B-8B, 8B+ tokens. Discounts escalate by breakpoint per attached SOW.

2) Model pricing and premiums
- Embeddings: we will provision a per-embedding-unit SKU for vector-only operations for 12 months, with pricing locked for 12 months and a review at month 9.
- Premium chat models: temporary multiplier 1.3x for months 1-6, 1.35x months 7-12, then standard thereafter. This applies only to agreed model IDs in the SOW.

3) Rollovers and credits
- 30-day rollover allowed, capped at 20% of monthly committed volume.
- One-time onboarding credit of $25,000 applied in month 1.

4) Term and next steps
- 12-month term recommended. We can extend to 24 for deeper discounts if you want to explore.
- Attached: Nimbus_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf and the pricing slides. DocuSign link to sign the SOW: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/DocuSignEnvelopeId12345

If this aligns with your expectations, let's schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the SOW and procurement checklist and get DocuSign started. Rachel will coordinate onboarding timelines after signature.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
Attachments: Nimbus_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_slides_nov2026.pptx
